title: Fourier weight of a subset
statement: Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $S$ be a subset of the coordinate set $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The Fourier weight of $f$ at $S$ is the square of its Fourier coefficient at $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$S$ is a subset of the coordinate set
